move.title: Move Aide to the Applications folder?
move.body: Aide needs to be in the Applications folder to run in the background and update automatically. It will reopen from there.
move.failedTitle: Couldn’t move Aide to the Applications folder
move.failedBody: Drag Aide to the Applications folder in Finder, then open it from there.

signer.declined: Windows asked for permission to set up Aide’s signer, and permission wasn’t granted. Without it, this PC can’t store your owner key.
signer.notAdmin: Only an administrator account can make this PC a trusted device. Join as a machine only, or approve on another device.
signer.uacOff: User Account Control is turned off, so other programs could access your key. Turn it on to make this PC a trusted device.
signer.noTPM: This PC doesn’t have a TPM 2.0 security chip to store your owner key.
signer.failed: Aide’s signer couldn’t be set up (error {{code}}).
signer.notRunning: Aide’s signer didn’t start. Please try again.
signer.noHello: Windows Hello confirms this change, and it isn’t set up. Set it up in Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options (a PIN is enough), then try again.
signer.unlockFailed: How this PC unlocks its key couldn’t be changed (error {{code}}).

herConsoleBad: The console’s address isn’t one Aide opens.
